name: cublas_cublasStrsv_v2
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench test_cublasStrsv_v2.py. Single-precision triangular solve op(A)*x=b (in place, x is RHS then solution) via the real cuBLAS ctypes baseline. Following the test, A is built well-conditioned as randn(n,n)+5*I by gen_inputs (cuBLAS reads only the uplo triangle; the +5*I diagonal keeps it stable for both non-unit and unit diag). x is random len n*incx, lda=n. uplo/trans/diag varied per the parametrize. reference mutates x in place and returns it. Requires cuBLAS at eval time.
